baseline.sourceFinding: Step 4 identified hud_layout_clear as generated-game-event-dependent evidence rather than independent HUD geometry proof.

rootCause.primary: HUD layout fidelity could be self-attested by generated game events named hud_layout_clear / hud_overlap_detected.
rootCause.prerequisite: The factory engine exposed logical W/H and CSS sizing but the assembled production canvas did not explicitly align its intrinsic drawing buffer to that logical size before game drawing.

mechanism: Playwright installs a verifier-owned CanvasRenderingContext2D observation hook before generated game code runs.
The hook observes actual text and rectangle draw geometry with current Canvas transforms and text metrics.
HUD candidates are derived from recent rendered edge-region text and containing rendered rectangles.
The verifier checks pairwise overlap and out-of-bounds geometry independently of generated-game events.
Legacy hud_layout_clear and hud_overlap_detected probes are normalized to layout_no_overlap and therefore lose self-attestation authority.
Assembled GF.Game canvases explicitly align intrinsic width/height to the engine logical W/H before generated scenes draw.

adversarialValidation.spoofedLegacyEvent: FAIL as intended when hud_layout_clear exists but no independent layout snapshot exists
adversarialValidation.greenGeometryFixture: PASS with three independently observed non-overlapping HUD regions
adversarialValidation.overlapGeometryFixture: FAIL as intended when two rendered HUD panels overlap
adversarialValidation.canvasDimensionAssertion: PASS: logical and intrinsic canvas dimensions match in assembled runtime fixture

limitations: This is geometry evidence from actual Canvas draw calls, not computer-vision or semantic image understanding.

HUD-region discovery deliberately uses a bounded edge-zone plus containing-rectangle heuristic; arbitrary non-text HUD graphics without observable text/rect geometry are not claimed as semantically classified.
The repair proves overlap and canvas-boundary integrity for observed HUD regions; it does not claim artistic quality or readability by itself.
